thread:
harper: Weird one  found a jar of cold lentil soup labeled "do not eat" but no name. Did someone leave a science experiment in the fridge? :crying_cat_face:
samir: Not mine. But also saw a tiny paper with "might contain sneeze" written? who writes that kind of label 😂
jin: omg that was probably me from yesterday  i was reheating and sneezed on the rim then panicked and labeled it. apologies team, i moved it to the amnesty box.
ealexa: PSA: please always put lids on containers. we have a fruit fly fiesta brewing. also paper towels in the janitor closet are low.
kitchen-ops: Thanks for the flag. New rule added to the fridge sticky: lid yes, name+date yes, "sneeze humor" not recommended. We'll restock paper towels tomorrow AM.
pantry-bot: Inventory ping: paper_towels=1_roll, cling_wrap=0, single_use_cutlery=12, lentil_soup_unlabeled=0 (moved to amnesty_box). Low items flagged: cling_wrap.
marta: Quick volunteer call: who can swing by the corner deli after 5pm for cling wrap + a pack of small soup containers? i'll reimburse. React :hand: if you can.
samir: :hand: I can go and grab 6 containers. Anyone want soup for tomorrow lunch? I'll bring mine in a disposable container.
harper: I'll take one. Also can we get a small sign that says "Please reseal & label" with a smiley? The weird notes are funny but also stressful for the fridge.
jin: I can design a tiny sticker and leave it by the label printer. Also, new suggestion: put a tiny transparent bag for single-use cutlery so we stop digging in the drawer.
kitchen-ops: Good ideas. Sticker placed above the printer. I'll put a clear sandwich bag dispenser on the wall. Reminder: unlabeled food goes to amnesty for 24h then donated or discarded.
pantry-bot: Poll: Snack subscription? Optional $4/mo for basics (tea, sugar, filters). React :thumbsup: yes, :thumbsdown: no.
harper: :thumbsup: fine by me. saves awkward Venmo math.
marta: Thanks all. Jin  no worries, we all sneeze. Just maybe avoid using the rim as a tissue next time. :kissing_smiling_eyes:
samir: Heading out at 5:10. ping if you want me to pick anything else.
